preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated BNB from taxes

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the sweepContingency() function before liquidity is added to drain all BNB from the contract to the owner's address. Alternatively, after liquidity is added, use manualDeposit() to send contract BNB to the reflector contract, then manipulate the reflector to extract funds. The owner can also set tax wallets to their own addresses to receive all tax distributions.
